summary: Initialization helper that queries subsystem readiness for indices 0 through 13 via SubsystemReadyQuery and stores each result into an array of 14 dwords at this+0xB70 (this+732). Runs unconditionally on all 14 indices and returns the last readiness value. Called from LoadingPhase1 (0x004B87C0) during startup initialization.

local_names.this: object whose subsystem-ready table is being populated

operations.description: Initialize subsystem index v2 to 0 and the array cursor v3 to this+732 (offset 0xB70).
do-while loop that runs while v2 < 14, populating one table entry per subsystem index 0..13.
Call SubsystemReadyQuery(this, v2) to query readiness of subsystem v2 and store its return value as result.
Store the readiness result into the current entry of the table at this+0xB70.
Advance index v2 and array cursor v3 for the next iteration.

unresolved: Semantic meaning of each subsystem readiness value returned by SubsystemReadyQuery is unknown here; entries are stored verbatim.
The packet field table lists only the array at this+0xB70; the 14 entry types are not enumerated.
